text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion is set to run in the Arima 
Kinen. Among today's competitors are her 
friend Daiwa Scarlet, and—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's Air Shakur...!
She declares she won't 
let you leave like this.
Fierce sparks fly 
between the two.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The final race for Fine Motion is about
to 
begin—!
